plan.goal: Report the binary .bed size, per-chromosome .bed size, and number of per-chromosome files for a GWAS genotype dataset of 3438 samples and 1478480 variants (960451 on the largest chromosome).
plan.rationale: This is a pure PLINK dataset-sizing calculation. The full binary .bed packs 2 bits per sample per variant (n_samples × n_variants / 4 / 1e6 MB). The per-chromosome .bed applies the same rule to the largest chromosome's variant count (960451). The number of per-chromosome files equals the number of chromosomes represented; the largest chromosome (chr1, 960451 variants) indicates a human dataset with 22 autosomes + X + Y + MT = 25 chromosomes.
caveats: The number of per-chromosome files (25) assumes a standard human dataset (22 autosomes + X + Y + MT); confirm the actual chromosome count in the .bim file if the dataset excludes sex chromosomes or mitochondria.
The per-chromosome .bed size reported is for the largest chromosome (960451 variants); other chromosomes will be smaller.
Sizes assume standard 2-bits-per-sample-per-variant binary packing; .bim and .fam files add negligible additional overhead.
